The '''Batravia system''' lay in the [[Serathrace sector/Legends|Serathrace sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of [[Batravian gumplucker]]s.<ref name="Luke">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Batravian gumplucker]]s|system=Batravia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Batravia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-11.<ref name="TEA" />
